title: Understanding Gradient Descent
text: Gradient Descent (GD) is an optimization algorithm used to minimize a function by iteratively moving towards the minimum value of the function. It uses the gradient of the function to determine the direction of the steepest descent.

title: Effect of Learning Rate
text: The learning rate in Gradient Descent determines the size of the steps taken towards the minimum. A larger learning rate means larger steps, while a smaller learning rate means smaller steps.

title: Increasing the Learning Rate
text: If the learning rate is increased, the steps taken by Gradient Descent will be larger. This can lead to faster convergence, but it also increases the risk of overshooting the minimum.

hintAnswer: The algorithm might converge faster, but it could also overshoot the minimum or even diverge.
